question: Avocado Real brand owner company
markdown:
The organic mattress and eco-friendly lifestyle brand
Avocado Green Mattress
is owned by its parent company,
Avocado Green Brands
, which was formed after a 2018 merger with Brentwood Home. The company is privately held and led by CEO Vy Nguyen alongside co-founders including Jeff D'Andrea and Mark Abrials.
